gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants with histologically confirmed diagnosis of surgically accessible recurrent/progressive glioblastoma will be enrolled in this study

candidate_evidence.quote: patients receive pembrolizumab IV over 30 minutes.
Patients also receive ATL-DC ID with poly ICLC IM every 2 weeks for up to 3 doses

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Be at first or second relapse

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: I. To evaluate the influence of pembrolizumab on the cell cycle-related genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment of progressive/recurrent glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: Beginning 14 days prior to scheduled surgery, patients receive pembrolizumab IV over 30 minutes.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy with monoclonal antibodies, such as pembrolizumab, may help the body's immune system attack the cancer

agents.agent_name_registered: Dendritic Cell Tumor Cell Lysate Vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Dendritic Cell Tumor Cell Lysate Vaccine (other names: DC tumor cell lysate vaccine, dendritic cell-pulsed tumor cell lysate vaccine)

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous tumour lysate-pulsed dendritic cell vaccine
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Vaccines, such as ATL-DC vaccine, may help the body build an effective immune response to kill tumor cells.

role_evidence.quote: Patients also receive ATL-DC ID with poly ICLC IM every 2 weeks for up to 3 doses

agents.drug_class_hint: TLR3 agonist immune adjuvant (polyinosinic-polycytidylic acid stabilized with polylysine and carboxymethylcellulose)

source_quote.quote: TIL quantification including tumor quantification of PD-1, PD-L1, CD3, CD4, CD8, Iba-I, Ki-67 measured by immunohistochemistry of FFPE tissue

biomarkers.biomarker_other: cell cycle-related gene expression signature (RNA-seq/NanoString IO360)

source_quote.quote: gene expression signature and somatic mutations in the tumor measured by RNA Seq and nano string IO360

coder_notes: Placebo Administration (Other, IV) is registered but has no active moiety, so not listed as an agent. Poly ICLC is given in both arms as vaccine adjuvant, coded soc_backbone (given equally in all arms); pembrolizumab is the only investigational non-excluded agent. Biomarkers are pharmacodynamic only, not eligibility/enrichment, so they do not affect the primary outcome.
